 ORDER

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicants, who are apprehending their arrest in connection with Crime No.1368/2019-RCT for offences punishable under sections 420, 467, 468, 472, 34 and 120-B of IPC registered at Police Station - Civil Line, District Morena.

entities.text: Police Station - Civil Line, District Morena
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
In this case on a private complaint concerned Magistrate has taken cognizance under Sections 420,
467, 468, 472, 34 and 120-B of IPC against the present applicants/accused persons.
The allegation against the applicants are that they took money in the sum of Rs.7,60,000/- from the complainant on false promise of employment and also gave him forged appointment letter.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants are innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further argued that the matter was already settled between the parties and the application was filed on behalf of both the parties; however, the same was dismissed by the learned Trial Court.
The fact of settlement is apparent from the order sheet dated 19.4.2022.
It is further argued that the complainant refused for compromise when the application was dismissed by the learned trial Court.
Prima facie, there is no evidence to prove that forged appointment letter was given to complainant as no document has been filed.
Only photocopies are filed before the learned trial Court even evidence of handwriting expert has not been adduced.
In these circumstances, the applicants are entitled to get the benefit of anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the respondent No.2 opposed the application and prays for its rejection in the light of gravity of offence.
However, learned counsel for the State conceded that applicants are not having any criminal history as per record.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and material available on record, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicants be released on bail on furnish a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Authority.
